> Blog · Prestige · 2026-08-01

# Brief
- Title: Backwater Valves: The One-Way Valve That Stops a Sewer Backup
- Slug: /blog/backflow-preventer/. It keeps this slug to match the pillar's existing link, since "backflow preventer" is the layperson term.
- Role: Support 3. Intent: informational and commercial research. About 1,430 words.
- Primary keyword: backwater valve. Secondaries: sewer backflow preventer, do I need a backwater valve, how does a backwater valve work, backwater valve vs backflow preventer, backwater valve Bluffton SC.

# Angle
A backwater valve sits on the sewer lateral, lets wastewater out and closes if sewage tries to come back in. The post separates it from a water-supply backflow preventer, explains how it works, who needs one in the Lowcountry, what it will not do (it does not fix a clog in your own line), installation and maintenance, and has an FAQ. It closes the pillar loop: the pillar's backflow mention links here.

# Flag status
- Publish after the pillar and the rain post (it links up to both).
- The flap and float mechanism is hard to render accurately with AI images. Consider a real product photo or a simple labeled diagram.
- First-hand proof is optional. Gated for Scott: valve pricing and install cost, free language, warranties, emergency rates.

# Status
